100.$description: Pale green status background tint. Reserved for feedback; not a brand or decorative color.

500.$description: Green status color for fills, text, borders, and icons. Provides at least 5:1 contrast with white. Reserved for feedback.

900.$description: Dark green for emphasized status text on the 100 tint. Provides at least 7:1 contrast with its tint. Reserved for feedback.

100.$description: Pale blue status background tint. Reserved for feedback; not a brand or decorative color.

500.$description: Blue status color for fills, text, borders, and icons. Provides at least 5:1 contrast with white. Reserved for feedback.

900.$description: Dark blue for emphasized status text on the 100 tint. Provides at least 7:1 contrast with its tint. Reserved for feedback.

100.$description: Pale amber status background tint. Reserved for feedback; not a brand or decorative color.

500.$description: Amber status color for fills, text, borders, and icons. Provides at least 5:1 contrast with white. Reserved for feedback.

900.$description: Dark amber for emphasized status text on the 100 tint. Provides at least 8:1 contrast with its tint. Reserved for feedback.

100.$description: Pale red status background tint. Reserved for feedback; not a brand or decorative color.

500.$description: Red status color for fills, text, borders, and icons. Provides at least 6:1 contrast with white. Reserved for feedback.

900.$description: Dark red for emphasized status text on the 100 tint. Provides at least 8:1 contrast with its tint. Reserved for feedback.

default.$description: Default body text color; aliases the brand palette because no neutral gray scale is available yet.

primary.$description: Text in the primary role; aliases role.primary.

secondary.$description: Text in the secondary role; aliases role.secondary.

success.$description: Success text on the default background; aliases the green status color.

info.$description: Informational text on the default background; aliases the blue status color.

warning.$description: Warning text on the default background; aliases the amber status color.

danger.$description: Danger text on the default background; aliases the red status color.

light.$description: Text in the light role; aliases role.light.

dark.$description: Text in the dark role; aliases role.dark.
